Record requests today move through fax machines, phone trees, and manual follow-up, a process that can take weeks and routinely stalls the legal and clinical decisions that depend on it. We use AI in conjunction with human review to pull decision-ready records in a fraction of the time, with a level of accuracy legacy vendors can't match. jobs.description: Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. The Community You Will Join: Reputation is a new, global team at Airbnb with a mandate to address and measure how communities, cities, regulators and guests see us. We're accepting applications for a Senior Staff Data Scientist (part of Airbnb's Data Science organization, on the Economics and Policy Data Science team) who will be a dedicated data partner for Reputation, working with the VP of Reputation and the Reputation leadership team. Candidates should have a strong background in data modeling, sentiment analysis, and measurement, including via surveys and causal inference methods. Candidates must also have demonstrated skill in organizing, communicating, and presenting analysis to executives through frameworks, dashboards, reports and other tools. The Difference You Will Make: You will help establish a global measurement framework for understanding how people think and feel about Airbnb, and why. The focus will be not just users of the product, but the general public. Like the Reputation team itself, this role will require partnership across Airbnb. jobs.description: About the Team The Health team, within OpenAI’s broader Post Training organization, has a mission to ensure AGI improves health for all humanity. Improving human health will be one of the defining impacts of AGI. Hundreds of millions of people already turn to ChatGPT for questions about their health and millions of clinicians use it weekly to support care delivery. Increasingly capable models create an opportunity to make high-quality medical intelligence more accessible across patients and clinicians—raising the floor of human health—and accelerate the new capabilities and scientific advances that raise the ceiling of human health. Our job is to make those benefits real. We work across the full model stack—pretraining, midtraining, reinforcement learning, post-training, evaluations, harnessing, and deployment—and connect that research to the patients, clinicians, and real-world outcomes we aim to improve. About the Role We’re looking for an exceptional, hands-on researcher who wants to build frontier health capabilities and turn them into impact at scale. This is a role for someone who can take an important, underdefined problem from 0→1: identify the right bet, build what’s needed to test it, and drive it all the way to a measurable improvement in the models and products we actually ship. We’re especially excited about two kinds of people: researchers with the technical depth to move the frontier in pretraining, reinforcement learning (RL) / post-training, or evals; and researchers with real depth in developing frontier biomedical AI capabilities. Prior experience in healthcare is helpful but not required. Research excellence, velocity, ownership, and alignment with the mission are most important to us. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. jobs.title: Research Engineer / Research Scientist, Human Flourishing
jobs.description: About the Team The Human Flourishing team’s mission is to ensure AI systems understand and advance human flourishing. As AI becomes more capable and plays a larger role in people’s lives, we want its human benefits to grow with its capabilities. The Human Flourishing team is part of the broader Post Training organization. Our approach has two parts. Firstly, we measure and improve models’ understanding, capability, and propensity to act according to people’s values and to help them achieve their long-term goals. Secondly, we directly scale tangible impact for users in human domains like education and mental health, working across research, product, and partnerships to increase the benefits over a billion people experience weekly when they use ChatGPT. Our recent work includes Beneficial RL https://alignment.openai.com/beneficial-rl/, which investigates how training for beneficial behavior generalizes across settings, and MentalHealthBench https://openai.com/index/introducing-mentalhealthbench/, a benchmark developed with mental health experts to evaluate realistic conversations. About the Role We’re looking for an exceptional, hands-on researcher to turn difficult-to-define signals of long-term flourishing into measurable improvements in model behavior. You’ll help set research direction, build what is needed to test your ideas, and drive successful work into the models and products we ship. We’re especially interested in researchers with deep experience improving frontier models through pretraining or reinforcement learning (RL) / post-training, especially on less verifiable problems, or researchers who combine strong LLM skills with deep expertise in domains like education or mental health. Prior experience in these domains is not required. In this role, you will - Develop scalable training methods across the training stack that improve how models understand people’s values, support their agency, and help them achieve long-term goals. - Lead high-leverage research

We're laying the technical foundations for AI that can anticipate what users need in real time, adapt as their goals and preferences shift, and build a deeper, evolving understanding of the person it's helping. jobs.title: Research Engineer / Research Scientist, Post-Training — Collective Alignment (User Signals)
jobs.description: About the Team The Collective Alignment (User Signals) team is a post-training research team working at the intersection of data science, human feedback, and reinforcement learning. We develop methods for learning from real-world user interactions to build AI systems that deliver lasting value, helping people learn, grow, and accomplish increasingly complex goals with ChatGPT. Learning from user feedback presents fundamental research challenges: signals are often noisy, biased, and difficult to interpret, and improvements in offline metrics do not always translate into better experiences for users. Our team develops scientific approaches to understanding these signals and translating them into improvements in model behavior through evaluations, reward modeling, and post-training. About the Role As a Research Engineer or Research Scientist, you will investigate how AI systems can learn from human feedback and real-world usage to better serve users over time. You will develop new approaches to extracting meaningful learning signals from complex user interactions and incorporating those signals into model training. This role requires strong deep learning research skills, scientific rigor, and curiosity about how people interact with AI. You will design controlled experiments and ablations, critically examine the relationship between offline evaluations and online model behavior, and work closely with research, product, and data science teams to understand whether improvements translate into meaningful value for users. In this role, you will: - Develop novel methods for learning from human feedback and user interaction signals. - Research approaches to incorporating feedback into reward modeling, reinforcement learning, and post-training. - Design rigorous experiments and ablation studies to isolate the effects of new data, objectives, and training methods. - Develop offline evaluations and investigate their relationship with online experiments and real-world user outco
